stem: According to the socioecological model, which factor would be categorized under the 'public policy' level of influence?

options.text: National investment in agriculture and food trade policies

explanation: Regional and national investment and trade policies represent the outermost 'public policy' layer of the model.
rationale: This level involves government-led decisions that affect the entire nation's food or transport systems.

optionExplanations.A: This is generally categorized at the family or interpersonal level within the model.
optionExplanations.B: Regional and national investment and trade policies represent the outermost 'public policy' layer of the model.
optionExplanations.C: This is the most central level of the model, focusing on the individual's internal factors.
optionExplanations.D: This falls under the 'community and built environment' or institutional level.
